(a) ContinuityDR(Isomap) (b) TrustworthyDR(CDA)
In this section, the performance of the proposed method in
visualizing medical images is evaluated , and compare it with
continuity and trustworthy dimension reduction methods. Two
data sets are used: first one has dimension 146x190x6 and the
second one has 175x160x6. It should be note, the comparisons
between methods are done with assumption that they have the
same geodesic distance matrix. The comparisons will base on
visualquantityandquality.
